_readme: Copy to data/profile.json and replace every value. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Leave out anything you don't want sent to the models. Any leaf can be {"value": ..., "about": "what this means"} to explain a custom field.

compensation._note: Amounts are ANNUAL, in rupees. LPA and monthly versions are derived automatically.

experience.title: Software Engineer II
experience.summary: Backend services in Python and Go; led the migration of billing jobs to event-driven workers.

school._note: Class 10 and Class 12, which Indian forms ask separately from your degree. Leave out what you don't want filled.

_optional: Add when forms ask: personal.date_of_birth (YYYY-MM-DD), personal.father_name, personal.mother_name, personal.has_valid_passport (true/false), self_identification.marital_status. A question about one of these that your profile leaves out is always asked, never guessed.

self_identification._note: Optional. Watching, questions about gender, caste, disability etc. always ask you first. Unattended, a voluntary EEO question gets its decline option (decline_eeo: false turns that off) unless you set an answer here.
